description: Read the current price one oracle provider reports for one asset. Use it for a single fresh or cached provider read (for example when a route quote needs a reference price). Do not use it for cross-provider consensus, historical series, deviation or risk analytics — use get_price_analytics instead. Returns the price, provider, symbol, chain, confidence/decimals, source timestamp and cache status.

provider.description: Oracle provider, e.g. chainlink, redstone, api3

name: get_oracle_price
